BL-2037 — A local seat's phase record carries its notes between arrange, act and assert - each parcel on a local-model seat runs as phases (arrange gathers, act changes, assert checks), each in a fresh session, and a per-parcel record in the seat's worktree holds the phase, the failed-assert count and every phase's notes - slice 1 of 2: the record and the command that moves it
What it solves: ## What is wanted
Approval context: Your intake (backlog/INTAKE-fight-a-too-small-contect-window-20261006.md), with the three design choices you answered in the specifier's console on 2026-10-06: a fresh session at each phase boundary; every parcel is phased (a parcel that changes no code goes from arrange straight to assert); a fail…
